title: Terms of use
content:

Please do not republish whole posts without asking. Trademarks, game art and screenshots belong to their respective owners and appear here for commentary and illustration.

The source code of this website is open source on GitHub, under the license in its repository.

## Code and advice

Tutorials, code snippets and recommendations are shared as they are, in the hope that they are useful. I cannot promise they are correct, complete or right for your situation. Use them at your own risk and test before relying on them.

## Comments and messages

You are responsible for what you post. Do not post spam, illegal content, or harassment. I may edit or remove any comment, and comments only appear after the site is rebuilt. By posting a comment you allow me to publish it on this site, with your name and the date. See the [privacy policy](/en/privacy/) for how your data is handled.

## Links and embeds

This site links to and embeds third-party content. I do not control those sites and I am not responsible for them.

## Liability

The site is provided as is, without warranties. To the extent the law allows, I am not liable for any damage that comes from using it or from relying on its content.

## Changes and law

I may update these terms, and the date at the top will change when I do. These terms are governed by Dutch law. Questions? Use the [contact page](/en/contact/).
